A perforating gun is `a specialized oilfield tool lowered into a wellbore to create holes (perforations) in casing or liner, allowing oil and gas to flow from the reservoir into the well` . These devices use shaped explosive charges or sometimes bullets to pierce the steel casing, cement, and surrounding rock formation.[[1]](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/perforating-gun#:~:text=perforating%20gun%20in%20the%20Oil,wells%20in%20preparation%20for%20production.)[[2]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforating_gun#:~:text=%23,gun%2C%20high-shot%20density%20gun)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/drilling.professionals/posts/perforation-gun-types-/1121081533016448/#:~:text=Shaped%20charges%20accomplish%20penetration%20by,1y%20%C2%B7%201%20like)[[4]](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/engineering/perforating-gun#:~:text=2.7.,%E2%80%A2)[[5]](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/what-perforating-gun-uses-how-works-top-companies-ngptc/#:~:text=Lowering%20the%20Gun%20into%20the,extracting%20hydrocarbons%20through%20these%20pathways.)[[6]](https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/documents/casingperforatedoverview.pdf#:~:text=The%20primary%20objective%20of%20a%20perforating%20gun,cement%20sheath%20and%20into%20the%20productive%20formation.)

**Key Details and Usage Examples:** 

- **Purpose:** To connect the reservoir to the wellbore, enabling production.
- **Deployment Methods:** Commonly lowered via wireline (accurate depth control), tubing (for deep/high-angle wells, known as TCP), or coiled tubing.
- **Operation:** The gun is activated electrically or mechanically to detonate the charges.
- **Applications:** Used in cased hole completions to initiate production, and often used in fracturing operations.
- **Components:** Contains a gun barrel, shaped charges, and a detonator.[[1]](https://www.slb.com/resource-library/oilfield-review/defining-series/defining-perforating#:~:text=Wireline-conveyed%20perforating%20has%20several,and%20weight%20and%20wellbore%20geometry.)[[2]](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/perforating-gun#:~:text=perforating%20gun%20in%20the%20Oil,wells%20in%20preparation%20for%20production.)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/drilling.professionals/posts/%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%97%BF%F0%9D%97%B3%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%BF%F0%9D%97%AE%F0%9D%98%81%F0%9D%97%B6%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%BB-%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%98%81%F0%9D%97%B5%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%B1%F0%9D%98%80types-of-perforation-methods1-conventional-perforation-bullet/1148109000313701/#:~:text=immediately%20after%20detonation.-,Process:%20A%20shaped-charge%20perforating%20gun%20is%20used%20in%20an,1y)[[4]](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/what-perforating-gun-uses-how-works-top-companies-ngptc/#:~:text=Lowering%20the%20Gun%20into%20the,extracting%20hydrocarbons%20through%20these%20pathways.)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perforation_%28oil_well%29#:~:text=A%20perforation%20in%20the%20context,perforate%20the%20casing%20or%20liner.)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ZQ9yjzreNo&t=31)

**Synonyms and Related Terms:** 

- **Perforator** 
- **Downhole gun** 
- **Shaped-charge gun** 
- **Casing gun** 
- **TCP Gun** (Tubing-Conveyed Perforating)[[1]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforate#:~:text=1.%20vb.%20%5BPerforating%5D,between%20formation%20stresses%20and%20productivity.)[[2]](https://aoghs.org/technology/oil-well-perforating-guns/#:~:text=The%201930s%20brought%20various%20downhole,against%20accidental%20or%20inadvertent%20operation.%E2%80%9D)[[3]](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/engineering/perforating-gun#:~:text=2.7.,%E2%80%A2)[[4]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforating_gun#:~:text=%23,gun%2C%20high-shot%20density%20gun)[[5]](https://www.facebook.com/drilling.professionals/posts/%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%97%BF%F0%9D%97%B3%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%BF%F0%9D%97%AE%F0%9D%98%81%F0%9D%97%B6%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%BB-%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%98%81%F0%9D%97%B5%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%97%B1%F0%9D%98%80types-of-perforation-methods1-conventional-perforation-bullet/1148109000313701/#:~:text=immediately%20after%20detonation.-,Process:%20A%20shaped-charge%20perforating%20gun%20is%20used%20in%20an,1y)

Types include retrievable hollow carrier guns (leave little debris) and expendable guns. According to the [[SLB Perforating Fundamentals](https://www.google.com/search?q=SLB+Perforating+Fundamentals&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjApu6klpGUAxV0hSsGHS7rG4UQgK4QegQIBxAC) (https://www.slb.com/resource-library/oilfield-review/defining-series/defining-perforating), this is a critical step in well completion.[[1]](https://www.slb.com/resource-library/oilfield-review/defining-series/defining-perforating#:~:text=Wireline-conveyed%20perforating%20has%20several,and%20weight%20and%20wellbore%20geometry.)[[2]](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/engineering/perforating-gun#:~:text=2.7.,%E2%80%A2)[[3]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforating_gun#:~:text=%23,gun%2C%20high-shot%20density%20gun)

items.title: What does a perforating gun do?

expanded_element.title: Casing Perforating Overview | EPA
expanded_element.description: The primary objective of a perforating gun is to provide effective flow communication between the cased wellbore and a productive reservoir. To achieve this, the perforating gun “punches” a pattern of perforation through the casing and cement sheath and into the productive formation.

items.title: What are the regulations for perforating guns?

expanded_element.title: STORAGE - ATF
expanded_element.description: During transportation of perforating guns, Department of Transportation regulations require a detonator interrupter device to be placed between the detonators and detonating cord, which prevents the possibility of an unintended initiation.

items.title: What is the purpose of perforating?

expanded_element.title: What Are Perforations? | What Are They & How They're Made
expanded_element.description: A perforation is a small hole or row of holes punched into a material — commonly found on paper, plastics, and packaging products — so a part of it can be easily torn off. The purpose of a perforation is to make a material easy to tear or bend.

items.title: How safe is it to operate a perforating gun?

expanded_element.title: Top Perforating Gun Safety Practices - MSI Pipe Protection Technologies
expanded_element.description: Although perforating operations are necessary, it's also a hazardous process. Therefore, only trained and experienced operators should perform these kinds of tasks. And having perforating gun safety and other thread protective tools will only help enhance well-site practices during operations.
